newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-PSV AND FEYENOORD BOTH HELD TO DRAWS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PSV AND FEYENOORD BOTH HELD TO DRAWS.

text.p: Dutch league leaders PSV Eindhoven drew 2-2 away against NAC Breda on Sunday but stayed top of the table as second-placed Feyenoord also drew -- 0-0 against Vitesse Arnhem.

Both sides have 59 points but PSV have a far superior goal difference. Third-placed Twente Enschede trail by four points after losing 3-2 to bottom club RKC Waalwijk while Ajax stay fourth on 48 after beating Volendam 3-0 away despite having a man sent off.
PSV went ahead early on but NAC were the dominant team in the first half, scoring twice in rapid succession through Australian striker Alan Arambasic in the 27th minute and Ruud Brood in the 29th.
PSV emerged after the break as a different team, forcing NAC deep into their own half and creating several chances as they piled on the pressure.
However, they only managed one goal and it came via Belgian international Gille de Bilde, making his debut for the Eindhoven side, who converted a cross by Zeljko Petrovic.
Twente had previously lost only two away matches this season but conceded three goals in 39 minutes with some chaotic defending.
John Bosman scored twice for Twente but RKC won the match to hand the bottom-of-the-table slot to AZ Alkmaar.
Ajax coach Louis van Gaal decided to rest Marc Overmars ahead of Wednesday's first-leg European Cup semifinal against Juventus.
Also absent were Tijjani Babangida, on duty with the Nigerian national team, and Patrick Kluivert, who is awaiting surgery on a knee injury.
Kiki Musampa scored the opening goal six minutes before half-time but in the 55th they were reduced to ten men when Jari Litmanen was sent off for a foul.
However, they continued to go forward and went 2-0 up with a goal by Arnold Scholten in the 66th minute. Nordin Wooter completed the victory seven minutes from time.
